originals.ko: 나는 가능한 한 자주 이야기하기를 기대하고 있어
나는 멈추고 싶지 않아 왜냐하면 나는 이야기하기를 기대하고 있으니까

topups.ko: 나는 이야기하는 연습을 하기를 기대하고 있어 왜냐하면 그건 유용하니까

topups.why: '웨일스어를 이야기하기' is awkward Korean, and '웨일스어로 이야기하기' would collide with siarad yn y Gymraeg; B02 is stronger anyway
Fine, but only 1 BUILD is needed and B02 was chosen first
Fine, but only 1 BUILD is needed
Long and clunky; already have 3 stronger USE rows

originals.ko: 나는 지금 웨일스어로 무언가를 말하는 게 좋겠어
originals.why: This is 'well i mi' (I'd better), not the adverb 'yn well' (better). It never contains the LEGO, so it is the wrong sense for this basket

originals.ko: 나는 더 잘 이야기하는 연습을 할 거야
나는 지금 웨일스어로 무언가를 말하려고 노력하는 게 좋겠어
originals.why: 'well i mi drio' means I'd better try. That is not 'yn well', and the LEGO is absent, so it is the wrong sense

originals.ko: 나는 웨일스어로 다른 무언가를 말하려고 노력하는 게 좋겠어
originals.why: 'well i mi' means I'd better. That is not the adverb 'yn well', and the LEGO is absent, so it is the wrong sense

originals.ko: 나는 더 잘 대답하려고 노력하고 있어
나는 지금 더 잘 대답할 수 없어

refill.ko: 너는 웨일스어를 더 잘 이야기할 거야?
refill.why: In North Welsh, a line opening with 'wyt ti'n' is a question (the statement would be 'ti'n'), so the Korean must be a question too
Good Welsh, but 'liciwn i' has no gloss here, so ~하면 좋겠어 could also lead to 'baswn i'n licio' or 'dw i isio'; two kept rows already fill the need
Fine, but weaker than the two kept rows and not needed
Long phrase that is awkward to say, and 'yn well' is not the point of it; not needed
